# Prism Aurora Immersive

Skin ID: `prism-aurora`

Public name: Prism Aurora Immersive

Mood: immersive, futuristic, vivid, premium.

Best-fit niches: tech-forward coaches, modern personal brands, fitness/performance, standout visuals.

Visual metaphor: a controlled prism wellness-tech light field.

Structure:
- Hero: immersive luminous hero with prism media treatment.
- Background: CSS prism field with mesh fallback.
- Cards: luminous glow tiles.
- CTA: high-contrast luminous CTA.
- Navbar: glass/prism nav.
- Sticky CTA: luminous CTA bar with controlled glow.
- Bonus: prism glow product tiles.
- FAQ: glow accordion panels.
- Media: prism edge-lit cutout or framed media.
- Motion: controlled glow movement and card lift.
- Mobile: lower opacity and reduced motion.

Difference from default: prism light field, luminous card grammar, glow FAQ/bonus, and immersive hero.

Must not change: CTA href, Google Form behavior, legal/support links, analytics, bonus service names, FAQ data, inspect slot keys.
